meaning: 壮观的景色，奇妙的景象
usageNote: 名词短语！形容那种让你瞬间张大嘴巴的震撼美景，旅游攻略里超常见～

examples.en: The national park is full of wonderful sights that will take your breath away.
examples.zh: 这个国家公园充满了令人叹为观止的壮丽景色。

examples.en: Travelers come from all over the world to see the wonderful sights of this ancient city.
examples.zh: 游客从世界各地赶来，就为了一睹这座古城的奇妙景象。
